transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon! Thank you for calling TechSolutions. This is Sarah speaking. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi Sarah, I’m having trouble with my billing. I was charged twice this month for my Pro plan.

Agent: I’m sorry to hear that, and I can certainly help you with that! Could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

Customer: Sure, it’s john.doe@email.com. 

Agent: Thank you, John. Let me pull up your account. I see the double charge. It appears to be a billing system error. I apologize for the inconvenience.

Customer: That’s frustrating. Will I get a refund for the extra charge?

Agent: Absolutely, I can initiate that refund for you right now. It should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days.

Customer: Okay, that’s good to know. But I also wanted to ask if there are any new features coming to the Pro plan soon?

Agent: Yes! We're actually rolling out a new analytics dashboard next month. It’ll give you deeper insights into your usage statistics.

Customer: That sounds great! Is there any additional cost for that feature?

Agent: Not at all! It will be included in your current Pro plan at no additional charge.

Customer: Awesome! I really appreciate your help today, Sarah.

Agent: It’s my pleasure, John! Just to confirm, I’ll process your refund and look out for the analytics dashboard next month.

Customer: Perfect. Thanks again for your assistance!

Agent: You're very welcome! If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!

Customer: You too, bye! 

Agent: Goodbye!
